title: AstraZeneca, CSPC to form joint venture for biologics manufacturing
llm_note: AstraZeneca and CSPC are forming a new joint venture for biologics manufacturing in China.

title: Enzene Targets Local Biomanufacturing with New Solutions
llm_note: Enzene launched a partnership model to establish localized, continuous biomanufacturing capabilities globally.

title: CellFiber and Tidewave Bio Enter Collaboration to Evaluate Scalable 3D Manufacturing for Next-Generation Solid Tumor Immunotherapy
llm_note: CellFiber and Tidewave Bio are collaborating to evaluate automated 3D cell culture for scalable immunotherapy manufacturing.

title: Building a Bioprocessing Workforce Through Partnerships
llm_note: The St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital GMP facility is focused on strategies for sustaining a bioprocessing workforce.

title: New Bioreactor Design Could Boost mAb Yields
llm_note: Researchers have proposed an innovative rotating-drum bioreactor design to increase monoclonal antibody production yields.

title: Seamless Integration in Gene Therapy Process Development
llm_note: Contract manufacturer Forge Biologics is focused on consistency and process development for AAV production.
